title: A map of stalks of coherent modules comes from a map on a neighbourhood
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], $x\in X$, and $\psi:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules (stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]). Then there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and a homomorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $\varphi:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (restrictions $\mathcal F|_U(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ open) whose stalk map at $x$ is $\varphi_x=\psi$.

proof.text: The coherent source G is finite type directly by [pqf-def-coherent]. Choose finite local generating sections using IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData. Reindex each finite generator family by ULift (Fin n), so the coherence kernel clause applies. Invoke Scheme.Modules.isFinitePresentation_of_generators_kernel, the existing proved private helper of the module for [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], made available by a proof-only import all. It constructs finite local cokernel presentations from the finite generators and finite-type kernels [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Assemble these presentations using IsFinitePresentation.of_coversTop. This proves G.IsFinitePresentation without using local Noetherianity.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma Tag 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian), lines 2225-2270, equivalence of (1) and (3), invoked in proof of Lemma Tag 01Y4 (lemma-map-stalks-local-map), lines 2392-2407; local presentation expanded

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-internal-hom-finite-presentation] to G and F. Surjectivity of the supplied linear equivalence gives a preimage t of the linear map psi. Represent t by a germ of an internal-Hom section phi on U containing x, using Mathlib's TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. By [def-pur-sheaf-hom], phi is a morphism on the over-site. Turn it into a morphism of restricted scheme modules by applying Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U, conjugated by overFunctorEquiv U.

proof.text: For m in G_x, represent its image under restrictStalkNatIso.inv by a section s on an open V of U. The hom formula germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app and the inverse-hom identity show that the germ of s on the image open in X equals m. Evaluate the formula of [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-internal-hom-finite-presentation] at phi and s; since the germ of phi is t and e t = psi, its value is psi m. On the other hand, the germ formula for the stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], followed by germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app for F, gives exactly the same germ for the transported restricted morphism. Their equality proves the displayed pointwise conclusion.
